ns2:section.sectionText: George Frederic Handel (H. Schulze) A survey of the life and work of George Frederic Handel, in particular investigating, in his later compositions, the use of stylistic elements that Handel had adopted during his stay in Italy 1706-1709. Participants are expected to write and present an extensive research paper, to contribute to group assignments, and to actively participate in class discussions.
